## What changes for the user

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes (tests, translations, ES5 and no-comment lint)
- [ ] New visible text is in both `app/i18n/en.js` and `app/i18n/tr.js`, and the layout works in both languages
- [ ] No comments added to the code
- [ ] No `backdrop-filter` or animated `box-shadow` on moving or focus-changing elements
- [ ] Screenshots attached for UI changes (English and Turkish)
- [ ] Tested on a TV (model and Tizen version: ) or only in the desktop preview
